text: I don't feel good enough.
I have very little confidence in myself.
I always think I'm a failure.
I compare myself with everyone else.
I don't believe in my abilities.
I feel like I'm not smart enough.
I don't like the person I've become.
I feel worthless most of the time.
I never feel proud of my achievements.
I constantly criticize myself.
I don't think anyone values me.
I feel insecure about everything I do.
I don't think I'm capable of succeeding.
I feel like everyone is better than me.
I struggle to accept compliments.
I always doubt my decisions.
I feel like I disappoint everyone.
I wish I had more confidence.
I don't believe I deserve good things.
I feel invisible wherever I go.
